incidents.name: MUBank spot-price mint
incidents.notes: MUBank minted MUG against MU at the live MU/MUG pair price, so buying MU on the pair first and then depositing it let the attacker mint MUG at an inflated rate and sell it back for USDC.e.

sources.ref: onchain review: MUBank 0x4aA679402c6afcE1E0F7Eb99cA4f09a30ce228ab created 2022-12-09T18:20:29Z by 0xf243d79910cbd70a0eaf405b08e80065a67d5e14, not the attack-tx sender 0xd46b44a0e0b90e0136cf456df633cd15a87de77e; no EIP-1967 events, so the executing code was 7 hours old. Loss $57k per the DeFiHackLabs 2022 index entry for this PoC.
